name: tips_crm_secure_visit_attachments
query: INSERT INTO storage.buckets (id, name, public, file_size_limit, allowed_mime_types) VALUES ('visit-attachments', 'visit-attachments', false, 10485760, ARRAY['image/jpeg','image/png','image/webp','application/pdf']) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET public = false, file_size_limit = 10485760, allowed_mime_types = EXCLUDED.allowed_mime_types; CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tips_crm.visit_attachments (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), visit_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES tips_crm.visits(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, profile_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES tips_crm.profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, bucket_path text NOT NULL UNIQUE, file_name text NOT NULL, mime_type text, file_size integer, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()); ALTER TABLE tips_crm.visit_attachments ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; DROP POLICY IF EXISTS visit_attachments_owner_read ON tips_crm.visit_attachments; DROP POLICY IF EXISTS visit_attachments_owner_insert ON tips_crm.visit_attachments; DROP POLICY IF EXISTS visit_attachments_admin_read ON tips_crm.visit_attachments; CREATE POLICY visit_attachments_owner_read ON tips_crm.visit_attachments FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (profile_id = auth.uid()); CREATE POLICY visit_attachments_owner_insert ON tips_crm.visit_attachments FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (profile_id = auth.uid()); CREATE POLICY visit_attachments_admin_read ON tips_crm.visit_attachments FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (tips_crm.has_permission('view_team_data') OR tips_crm.has_permission('all')); DROP POLICY IF EXISTS visit_attachment_owner_select ON storage.objects; DROP POLICY IF EXISTS visit_attachment_owner_insert ON storage.objects; DROP POLICY IF EXISTS visit_attachment_admin_select ON storage.objects; CREATE POLICY visit_attachment_owner_select ON storage.objects FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (bucket_id = 'visit-attachments' AND (auth.uid()::text = (storage.foldername(name))[1] OR tips_crm.has_permission('view_team_data') OR tips_crm.has_permission('all'))); CREATE POLICY visit_attachment_owner_insert ON storage.objects FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (bucket_id = 'visit-attachments' AND auth.uid()::text = (storage.foldername(name))[1]);
